anti_selection.rule: A window that failed its whole-window verdict may be re-collected. A contradicted row inside a window that PASSED its verdict does NOT license re-collection to reverse it. Any successor characterization window carries an explicit predecessor link and both reports publish; the paper reports the sequence, never the more favourable member of it. The abandon-after-three rule at docs/paper/draft-v1.md:317 covers repeated environmental interruption and does not reach this case.

c2_floor_mode.activation_predicate: Select issued_floor_comparator if and only if, at freeze time, a same-cell operative floor has already been issued from a window with a strictly earlier freeze ordinal AND the set of evidence bundle digests behind that floor is disjoint from the set of null-ladder bundle digests. Otherwise select heldout_train_test. The predicate is evaluated once, at freeze, and its outcome is recorded in selected_at_freeze; it is never re-evaluated after outcomes are visible.

heldout_train_test.comparator: F_train, derived from the five floor_train blocks alone using the existing comparative point guard, its corner widening, and its guard factor; the five null_test blocks must not appear in that derivation
heldout_train_test.rationale: Conditional branch. It restores independence when no issued floor exists, at the cost of doubling the ladder to ten blocks per magnitude and of a weaker comparator: the committed guard factor is sqrt(9/(n-1)), so five blocks carry 1.5 while ten carry 1. Imposing it unconditionally would force the weaker comparator even where a stronger issued one is available.

issued_floor_comparator.comparator: the operative floor of the already-issued same-cell floor artifact, whose evidence is disjoint from these blocks
issued_floor_comparator.rationale: Primary. The null ladder's blocks are already held outside the prior floor's derivation, so non-circularity holds without splitting the ladder, and the comparator carries the stronger guard factor of an n>=10 derivation.

characterization_family.multiplicity_rule: The family is registered explicitly exploratory with no confirmatory inference, a formulation permitted by name at docs/contracts/analysis_plans.md:24. criteria.consequence_if_contradicted: The published drift allowance does not contain the drift actually observed on probes it was not built from, so the allowance understates within-window drift and every floor carrying it is re-derived with a larger allowance.
criteria.decision_rule: D_hold <= A_drift in both claim families
criteria.derivation_rule: A_drift = max(X, R_c) exactly as the window computes it, where X is the start/midpoint/end trajectory excursion over the allowance-constructing references only and R_c is the matching settled-corpus reference-repeatability bound. Held-out probes enter neither term.

estimator.formula: D_hold = max over held-out probes j of |H_j - R_mean|, where R_mean is the mean over the window's allowance-constructing reference members; computed separately for gross request energy and idle-subtracted request energy

criteria.limit_basis_source: docs/paper/draft-v1.md:244-250 defines A_drift and states in its own words that the start, midpoint, and end points document the allowance but cannot validate it: containment must be evaluated on held-out probes or later sessions.
criteria.quantity: largest deviation of a held-out reference probe from the window's allowance-constructing reference mean

criteria.consequence_if_contradicted: Recovery from a sustained workload takes longer than the settling convention allows, so the settling interval is raised to the observed maximum plus the registered margin in a successor policy edition and every window collected under the present convention is re-examined for admission validity.
criteria.decision_rule: max_j t_j <= 180

estimator.formula: t_j = the waited_s recorded on the cooldown note whose result is recovered, for the gate run after sustained hold j; report max_j t_j. The gate polls in five-second sub-windows and releases on a complete thirty-second rolling window with at least eighty percent duration coverage, duration-weighted mean power no more than 1.10 times the fixed clean reference, and nominal thermal pressure.

criteria.limit_basis_source: docs/phase_2/window_runbook.md:214 (SETTLE_S=180) and :135 ('Stage settle | 180 seconds'). This is the settling convention the row exists to adjudicate. It is a different mechanism from the cooldown gate's own refusal cap of 300 s (configs/campaign_policies/quiet_mac_p2_production.json cap_s), and the two must not be conflated: the criterion asks whether recovery in fact completes inside the settling convention, not whether the gate eventually released.
criteria.quantity: time from the end of a sustained workload to the first passing cooldown-exit evaluation
criteria.sample_unit: sustained hold and its following cooldown

criteria.limit_basis_source: The physical statement: session-to-session variation must not exceed the uncertainty a single session already admits to. If it does, the single-session bound understates what the instrument actually does between sessions.

rows.eligibility_predicate: A session is eligible if and only if: (i) its whole-window verdict is issued and PASSED; (ii) every stack-identity field matches the reference session exactly; and (iii) its capture-method era is a current claim-bearing anchor method. The eligible set is defined by this predicate and is NEVER enumerated: an enumerated list can be selected after outcomes are visible, a predicate cannot. Every session considered and excluded is listed in sessions_excluded with its reason.
rows.supplying_campaign: cross-window session index; no single campaign supplies this row
